points.text: The answer says that a standard hamper's contents is the standard list object itself rather than a copy of it.
The answer says that adding an extra appends it into the hamper's contents list in place.
The answer says that every standard hamper made up in the run holds the very same contents list.
The answer says that the dockets are written only after every order in the book has been made up.
The answer says that a bespoke hamper is packed into a fresh list built from its order's own wants.

disqualifiers.text: The answer claims that each standard hamper starts from its own copy of the standard list.
The answer claims that the cordial reached Mrs Beech's hamper through a mix-up of orders or an extra applied to the wrong hamper.
